name: Saegusa Akiko
source:
A housewife who lives next door to the protagonist's house. She has a family of 3, a husband and daughter.  35 years old.

She wanted to have a boy. Because of this, the protagonist is usually treated well by her in some way.

The protagonist's mother is divorced and not living with him, so she feels like a "kind mother" to him.

She is a former prostitute at a soapland

[from [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/mama-shibori.html]official site[/url]]
